engines.name: liteparse_md
engines.label: LiteParse + Tesseract (markdown)
engines.notes: Open-source light variant of LlamaParse. PDFium + bundled Tesseract OCR, markdown output.

engines.name: liteparse_text
engines.label: LiteParse + Tesseract (spatial text)
engines.notes: Same OCR, layout-preserving text output (columns kept as visual grid).

engines.name: liteparse_noocr
engines.label: LiteParse without OCR
engines.notes: Text-layer only. Expected ~0% on scans: proves the customer docs need OCR.

engines.name: liteparse_easyocr
engines.label: LiteParse + EasyOCR server
engines.reason: OCR server not reachable at http://localhost:8828/ocr (see liteparse/ocr/ README)

engines.name: liteparse_paddle
engines.label: LiteParse + PaddleOCR server
engines.reason: OCR server not reachable at http://localhost:8829/ocr (see liteparse/ocr/ README)

engines.name: tesseract
engines.label: Tesseract (raw CLI)
engines.reason: tesseract not installed (sudo apt install tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-deu tesseract-ocr-eng)
engines.notes: Plain tesseract on 200 dpi page images, lang deu+eng. The classic baseline.

engines.name: control_oracle
engines.label: Control: oracle (ground truth)
engines.notes: Returns the ground truth. Must score 0% error — validates the scoring.

engines.name: control_hallucinator
engines.label: Control: hallucinating VLM (simulated)
engines.notes: Simulates a fluent VLM failure: correct text, but with fabricated sentences, swapped digits and text invented for photo-only pages. Must rank worst on hallucination.

engines.name: kdl_frontier_nano
engines.label: KDL-Frontier-Parser-nano (full-page, experimental)
engines.notes: Leaderboard #1 on ParseBench. AGPL-3.0, 1.2B params, needs a GPU (vLLM).
